iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear talks and a reported uranium-transfer-to-China option reduce immediate breakout pressure, but 60% enriched-stockpile and inspection-continuity risk remain active; no verified higher-level jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: US-Iran and Israel-Iran exchanges remain the acute driver: Al Jazeera timeline and NYT/market reporting show strikes during the ceasefire period, oil export hub risk, and Hormuz restriction/mining risk, while talks and uneasy truce signals partially cap further escalation.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Fresh BBC/PBS/AP/France24 reporting shows Israeli evacuation orders, a declared southern Lebanon combat zone, overnight strikes and Hezbollah clashes; the post-truce environment is now worse than yesterday.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey scan produced no authoritative strategic warning, missile-range activity, or NATO crisis trigger; fresh items were mostly background or low-signal commentary.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains tense but below escalation threshold: Al Jazeera reports border demolition activity and India rebuked Pakistan at the UNSC, but no verified fresh force surge or cross-border battle surfaced; deconfliction channels remain relevant.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains imminent: fresh reporting cites Russia-Belarus nuclear drills across land, sea, and air plus allied warnings that Moscow may expand the war beyond Ukraine.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan scan was sparse in fresh hard triggers; baseline PLA/PLAN pressure remains, but no new blockade, direct clash, or major exercise surge was verified in the 24h window.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: Multiple fresh reports say North Korea tested new lightweight/multi-purpose launch systems, tactical cruise missiles, new warheads/technology and AI-guided missile capabilities; no device-event evidence surfaced.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains the highest raw tracker: fresh Kyiv Post/Kyiv Independent/MSN/London Business News items point to escalating Russian attacks, Oreshnik/hypersonic reporting, Patriot requests, and renewed nuclear threats.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan risk rose modestly: reports referenced Pakistani bombing/open-war language and Afghan border-violence displacement, while China-led mediation/Urumqi process coverage keeps diplomacy_active live.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical from the continuing SAF-RSF drone/infrastructure-strike pattern and external-backing allegations, but today’s fresh RSS scan produced no new Port Sudan-scale trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza/Jerusalem risk remains critical: fresh items say Israel killed a new Hamas military leader and strikes continue while ceasefire/hostage-deal optimism remains unresolved.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated on carried UNISFA/Abyei warning conditions and unauthorized-force concerns; no fresh 24h escalation item surfaced.
